selection_unit: one bounded, source-addressable recurrence or control spanning a protected center, contradiction or excluded alternative, gate or option-set effect, conversion instrument, and correction topology
selection_universe: all recoverable public-source episodes returned by mechanism- and gate-neutral search, including ordinary disagreements, lawful discipline, failed searches, inaccessible sources, successful updates, stays, substitutions, co-governance, value recovery, and negative results

frozen_query_templates.template: qualified contrary finding AND reclassified standing AND bounded gate action
eligible alternative excluded before decision AND later no credible alternative claim
low-status or outsider source AND later validated output AND gate consequence
public credential funding appointment or endorsement AND selection consequence
named role movement between institutions AND carried authority standard or workflow
separate organizations AND named interoperable interface AND operating responsibility
complete candidate or option denominator AND exclusion rule AND survivor consensus
failed bidder public capacity dissenting expert or alternative architecture AND blocked comparison route
external contradiction retained standing AND pre-action pause burden shift or correction
vendor or system replaced AND continuity evidence custody accountability and performance preserved
independent inspection disclosed error AND no effective pre-action or remedial authority
correction or governance change survived leadership vendor contract or successor system change

inclusion_rules: protected center and bounded gate are source-addressable
contradiction or excluded alternative is documented as reaching the decision surface
reclassification, option-set effect, conversion instrument, or correction topology is source-addressable
alternative explanations and counterevidence are retained
record is independently reopenable through named missing evidence or falsifier
exclusion_rules: preferred actor name, ideology, party, wealth, fame, or anticipated news value selects the episode
co-presence, career movement, shared investor, compatible vocabulary, or interface alone creates a recurrence
bad outcome substitutes for a contradiction-to-gate or option-set chain
ordinary disagreement or lawful discipline is treated as counterpower aversion without causal evidence
silence, nonresponse, or audience concentration substitutes for motive or monitoring evidence
